name: Flight Deck
pitch: A quiet flight instrument for tracing your coding history with exacting control.
tradeoff: Instrument precision sacrifices casual warmth and requires learning the compact model labels.
fontWhy: Michroma brings aerospace geometry, Saira readable labels, and Share Tech Mono fixed-width telemetry at 14px.
logoIdea: A target launches a continuous chamfered flight path, resolving into an open R.
sliderIdea: Two reticles bracket a day-ticked engineering ruler with readouts that follow each handle.
signatureMotion: Hairlines draw in staggered passes, model tapes roll, and a quiet reticle traverses the plot.
